exercises.prompt: Match each derived verb to its Form and maṣdar pattern.
exercises.explanation: Forms II, III, and IV all take ḍammah on the imperfect prefix (يُـ) and have distinct maṣdar patterns.

feedback.rule: Forms II, III, IV imperfects and maṣādir

exercises.prompt: True or False: The initial hamzah of Form IV (أَفْعَلَ, إِفْعَالٌ) is hamzat al-waṣl and drops after وَ.
exercises.explanation: False. Form IV always carries disjunctive hamzat al-qaṭʿ (وَأَنْزَلَ = wa-ʾanzala).

feedback.rule: Form IV uses hamzat al-qaṭʿ, never hamzat al-waṣl.
